title: Maple Roast Vegetables
summary: Roasting is one of the best techniques for getting the maximum amount of flavor out of vegetables. They become super tender, sweet on the inside and a bit caramelized on the outside.
ingredients: 7 carrots, peeled, sliced in half lengthwise, then cut into 2-inch pieces
2 red bell peppers, cut into large chunks
1 delicata squash, unpeeled, split lengthwise, seeds removed and cut into half moons
steps: Place all the vegetables on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat all the vegetables and sprinkle with salt. Alternatively at this point you can place the vegetables in a large zipper bag and refrigerate overnight.
Roast for 45-50 minutes, stirring halfway through, or until tender and golden.
Remove the vegetables from the oven, drizzle with maple syrup and roast an additional 5 minutes or until caramelized and golden.
Serve with additional salt to taste.
